
```{r}
library(vegan)
library(picante)
library(ggplot2)   

alpha_index <- function(x, method = 'richness', tree = NULL, base = exp(1)) {
    if (method == 'richness') result <- rowSums(x > 0)   
    else if (method == 'chao1') result <- estimateR(x)[2, ]   
    else if (method == 'ace') result <- estimateR(x)[4, ]    
    else if (method == 'shannon') result <- diversity(x, index = 'shannon', base = base)   
    else if (method == 'simpson') result <- diversity(x, index = 'simpson')   
    else if (method == 'pielou') result <- diversity(x, index = 'shannon', base = base) / log(estimateR(x)[1, ], base)   
    else if (method == 'gc') result <- 1 - rowSums(x == 1) / rowSums(x)    
    else if (method == 'pd' & !is.null(tree)) {   
        pd <- pd(x, tree, include.root = FALSE)
        result <- pd[ ,1]
        names(result) <- rownames(pd)
    }
    result
}
 

alpha_curves <- function(x, step, method = 'richness', rare = NULL, tree = NULL, base = exp(1)) {
    x_nrow <- nrow(x)
    if (is.null(rare)) rare <- rowSums(x) else rare <- rep(rare, x_nrow)
    alpha_rare <- list()
    
    for (i in 1:x_nrow) {
        step_num <- seq(0, rare[i], step)
        if (max(step_num) < rare[i]) step_num <- c(step_num, rare[i])
        
        alpha_rare_i <- NULL
        for (step_num_n in step_num) alpha_rare_i <- c(alpha_rare_i, alpha_index(x = rrarefy(x[i, ], step_num_n), method = method, tree = tree, base = base))
        names(alpha_rare_i) <- step_num
        alpha_rare <- c(alpha_rare, list(alpha_rare_i))
    }
    
    names(alpha_rare) <- rownames(x)
    alpha_rare
}
 
```


```{r}

otu <- read.csv("bac_otutab_paired.csv", row.names = 1)

otu_t <- t(otu)

richness_curves <- alpha_curves(otu_t, step = 2000, method = 'richness')

plot_richness <- data.frame()
for (i in names(richness_curves)) {
    richness_curves_i <- (richness_curves[[i]])
    richness_curves_i <- data.frame(rare = names(richness_curves_i), alpha = richness_curves_i, sample = i, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    plot_richness <- rbind(plot_richness, richness_curves_i)
}
 
rownames(plot_richness) <- NULL
plot_richness$rare <- as.numeric(plot_richness$rare)
plot_richness$alpha <- as.numeric(plot_richness$alpha)


group <- read.csv("bac_metadata_paired.csv")

plot_richness2 <- merge(plot_richness, group, by = "sample", all.x = T)


p1 <- ggplot(plot_richness2) +
  
  geom_line(aes(rare, alpha, group = sample, color = Habitat)) +
  
  labs(x = 'Number of sequences', y = 'Richness', color = NULL) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values =  c("#7B9DBB", "#EFB04B")) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  
  theme(legend.position = c(0.2, 0.8), )+
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 24000, linetype = 2) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24000, 5000), labels = as.character(seq(0, 24000, 5000)))


p1

```

```{r}

alpha_sample_rare = function(otutab, metadata, group_col = "Habitat", length = 52, rep = 30, count_cutoff = 1) {

  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggplot2")
  library(ggplot2)
  
  count <- otutab
  count[count < count_cutoff] <- 0
  count[count >= count_cutoff] <- 1
  
  sample_names <- colnames(count)
  groups <- metadata[match(sample_names, rownames(metadata)), group_col]
  group_list <- split(sample_names, groups)
  
  group_n <- sapply(group_list, length)
  min_n <- min(group_n)
  x <- unique(as.integer(seq(1, min_n, length.out = length)))
  
  result <- data.frame(sample = integer(), richness = numeric(), group = character())
  
  for (group_name in names(group_list)) {
    group_samples <- group_list[[group_name]]
    count_group <- count[, group_samples, drop = FALSE]
    n_group <- length(group_samples)
    
    for (i in x) {
      if (i > n_group) next
      m <- min(choose(n_group, i), rep)
      for (j in 1:m) {
        idx <- sample(n_group, i)
        temp <- count_group[, idx, drop = FALSE]
        temp1 <- temp[rowSums(temp) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
        richness <- dim(temp1)[1]
        result <- rbind(result, data.frame(sample = i, richness = richness, group = group_name))
      }
    }
  }
  
  result$sample <- as.numeric(as.character(result$sample))
  
  p <- ggplot(result, aes(x = sample, y = richness, color = group)) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.2, 0.8), )+
    labs(x = "Sample size", y = "Feature richness", color = group_col) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#7B9DBB", "#EFB04B")) 
  
  return(p)
}

```



```{r}

bac <- read.csv('bac_otutab_paired.csv', row.names = 1)

group <- read.csv("bac_metadata_paired.csv", row.names = 1)


p4 = alpha_sample_rare(bac, group, group_col = "Habitat", length= 52, rep=30, count_cutoff=1)

p4
```
